parsed.title: Inner mitochondrial membrane role
parsed.canonical_question: Why is the inner mitochondrial membrane important for ATP production?
parsed.match_reason: The learner asks why the tightness (impermeability) of the inner mitochondrial membrane is crucial for ATP production. This is semantically equivalent to the existing node's canonical question about why the inner membrane is important for ATP production. The node's summary directly addresses this: the inner membrane is impermeable to protons, forcing them through ATP synthase and coupling the gradient to ATP production.
